entries: It feels like something... is holding on to me. I cannot break from its grasp.
我感觉有什么……抓住了我。我挣不开它。
What is it that you feel?
I feel something... I did not expect a reaction so quickly.
我感觉到了什么……没想到反应来得这么快。
@, why do I let you get me into so much trouble?
@，我怎么就任你把我拖进这么多麻烦里？
Let me add just a bit of arcane energy...
